title: Commutativity of componentwise XOR
statement: For all $x, y \in \{0,1\}^n$, the componentwise XOR is symmetric: the vectors with $i$-th coordinates $x_i \oplus y_i$ and $y_i \oplus x_i$ coincide, so $x \oplus y = y \oplus x$.
hypotheses_covered: x, y are points of the Boolean hypercube of dimension n
replaced:
For all $x, y \in \{0,1\}^n$, coordinate-wise XOR satisfies
$x \oplus y = y \oplus x$.
